name: coverage-inspector
description: A band above the Git Inspector band with the health of the project's tests: last run, passed and failed, coverage and its trend, coverage of the changed lines, failing and flaky tests, and the next step. Works with any language.

testCommands.title: Extra test commands
testCommands.description: Comma-separated regular expressions for test commands the built-in list does not know, such as `make verify, ./ci\.sh`. Matched against each part of a Bash or PowerShell command.

coverageTarget.title: Coverage target (%)
coverageTarget.description: Line coverage the project should reach. The band turns the figure to a warning below it. 0 turns the target off.
